title: Looking for someone from my dreams
content: Hi! Call me Ye - not my real name. I'm 29 y.o now (to this date) I've been thinking if I should post it here but nah whatever. I have these dreams since I was young (17 y.o maybe) where I was with a guy/man that I could not remember the face until now. We look madly in love. Dream was at a beach house, sitting in a dock while looking at the sea with the unknown man. We look happy and he look like I was the one he ever wanted. and I still dream about it even to this day. I don't know why it always visit me in my dreams, maybe because I always thought about it. It was a recurring dream. I can't remember the face but in my dreams he wore light blue polo shirt, had a clean haircut,, just smiling for me. Every time I look at him it was like a blur moment of the past. But I haven't met the man my entire life. So if you have the same dream as mine and you think you might be the one I've been looking for leave me a message here. Thanks for reading.
